name: data-grid
title: Data Grid (editable)
description: Canvas-based editable spreadsheet grid (Glide Data Grid) with a row-object API and light/dark theming built from the current theme's tokens. Pass columns keyed to row fields plus rows; provide onRowsChange for editing.
docs: Glide Data Grid 6.0.3 declares React 16–18 as peers. It runs on React 19, but npm refuses the install. If it did, add "overrides": { "@glideapps/glide-data-grid": { "react": "$react", "react-dom": "$react-dom" } } to package.json and run the add again. pnpm and yarn only warn.
